Wisdom is more valuable than gold; knowledge, of more value than power.

    Seek to understand and your knowledge will be power; your wisdom will be of great worth.

智慧比黄金更珍贵；知识比力量更宝贵。

    求索理解之道，你的知识便会成为力量；你的智慧便会价值连城。

Within me lies protection from ignorance. My words are a lens through which to see.

     Common sense is a greater ward against evil than powerful magic.

我之中蕴藏着对抗愚昧的庇护。我的言语，是一面供你眺望的透镜。

     抵御邪恶，常识比强大的魔法更为可靠。

Seek knowledge. Gain understanding. But true Wisdom is knowing that you must control yourself, foremost.

This path is not safe, bur noeryt enescoh roeri mþnofyoc oio fivinroo aaþþnenun i þesngag.

求索知识。获得理解。然而真正的智慧，在于懂得：你首先必须驾驭自己。

此路并不安全，bur noeryt enescoh roeri mþnofyoc oio fivinroo aaþþnenun i þesngag.
(The words continue, but the rest of the book is unreadable for some reason. The language appears the same and yet you are unable to grasp its meaning)
（文字仍在继续，可这本书的其余部分不知为何无法辨读。语言看起来并无二致，你却怎么也读不懂它的含义）
